en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was asked, ‘What is the matter, the deceased tends to discharge semen?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The seed which he was Created from, is thrown out with’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy, from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Once, a person asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘
Why does a dying person discharge (semen)?’ He said, ‘It is the seed from which he is created that he throws out.’”
